response.answer: 1. Triage-first; 2. Phone-first. Triage-first matches your demonstrated evidence-led workflow: you build intake/evidence tables before deciding, perform strongly from notes, and support already uses a template identical to your own. You have also said ambiguity—not live calls themselves—is the issue. Phone-first would require real-time inference under ambiguity, and you described a prior phone-first trial where a confident live diagnosis was wrong. The ranking is based on your stated work preferences and experience, not a claim that you could not succeed in either rotation.
